description: Patterns available to proof-step verification, one entry per axiom, definition, and theorem. left/right are the original pattern (\Tc holes kept). leftTokens/rightTokens number operands by first appearance for matching and future tokenization. proofSteps are the extracted book steps for that theorem, when any exist.

evaluationNotes.\\Pu: Unary, same family as \Pe. The single operand points to null. \nPu is its negation.
evaluationNotes.if(...): Display-only wrapper on a branch condition (\Bb, \Bs, \Blb, \Bls). Removed before evaluation, so \Bb{if(i \Pe j)} is the same pattern as \Bb{i \Pe j}.
evaluationNotes.\\Pe: Same relation as \Oe. \Oe may be rewritten to \Pe by a rule; matching treats them as interchangeable.
